```bash
git clone https://github.com/aspose-cells-foss/Aspose.Cells-FOSS-for-Cpp.git
cd Aspose.Cells-FOSS-for-Cpp
git checkout 3e1edeacd4c1600507009c3fd3bf122d54f5d3a9
mvn clean install
```
